title: Beyond the 956: Body cam footage released in singer Jacquees' September DUI arrest in Florida
excerpt: Newly released body camera footage shows R&B singer Jacquees during his September 27 arrest in Hollywood, Florida, after officers found him passed out inside his white Jeep Gladiator. He was booked on charges of DUI, battery on an officer and resisting an officer without violence, and he has denied the allegations.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Newly released police body camera footage shows R&B singer Jacquees during his September arrest in Hollywood, Florida, after officers found him passed out inside his vehicle.

Jacquees, whose legal name is Rodriquez Jacquees Broadnax, 32, was arrested Sunday, September 27, 2026, in Hollywood, Florida, after police were called shortly before 8 a.m. about a man passed out behind the wheel of a white Jeep Gladiator near Hollywood Boulevard and North 62nd Avenue, according to TMZ and other reports.

The footage, obtained by TMZ from the Hollywood Police Department and published November 17, shows officers and firefighters surrounding the Jeep before Jacquees is moved to an ambulance and later to the back of a police cruiser. He appears to drift in and out of sleep during the encounter, at times lying on a stretcher and later on a bench at the jail. At one point in the footage, he is seen swatting at an officer's arm and exchanging heated words with officers.

Jacquees was booked on charges of driving under the influence, battery on an officer, firefighter or EMT, and resisting an officer without violence. He was released on a $3,500 bond. After his release, Jacquees denied the allegations, telling reporters the accusations against him were false and that he is an innocent man.

The charges remain allegations, and Jacquees is presumed innocent until proven guilty. The footage does not settle the outcome of the case, which remains pending.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post, November 17, 2026; TMZ, as reported by Hot 97, HotNewHipHop, Hollywood Unlocked and 105.1 The Bounce.
